name: Murray AI — P5.1 API Error Alert

parameters.content:
# Phase 5.1 — API Error Alert (reusable sub-workflow)

Called by every pipeline workflow whenever an external API call fails in a way that warrants a human-visible alert (credits out, auth busted, rate limit, provider outage). The classifier inspects provider + HTTP status + body and produces a Slack alert with:
- Which provider failed
- Most likely cause (credits / auth / rate limit / overloaded / network)
- Suggested action
- Originating workflow + node + context
- First 300 chars of the response body

Posts ONLY to `SLACK_ALERT_CHANNEL_ID` (C0AR99Q4ZUP). Never the approval channel.

## Inputs
| field | type | required | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | string | yes | `Apify` \| `Hunter` \| `Anthropic` \| `Monday` |
| `sub_provider` | string | no | `Crunchbase actor` |
| `status_code` | number | no | `402`, `429`, `0` for network |
| `workflow_name` | string | yes | `P2.1 Daily Lead Sourcing` |
| `node_name` | string | yes | `Apify - Crunchbase Actor` |
| `context` | string | no | `Daily lead fetch` |
| `error_body` | string | no | first 300 chars of response |

## Output
`{ posted: true|false, ts: '<slack ts>' }`

## Required env
- `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN`
- `SLACK_ALERT_CHANNEL_ID`

After you import this workflow, copy its workflow id from the URL and set:
`PHASE_5_API_ERROR_ALERT_WORKFLOW_ID=<id>`
in docker-compose.yml so the other workflows can call it.
